Name: HaoChiYu
Author: Otapot123
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]He goes by the name [b]"HaoChiYu"[/b] – a [b]wayfarer[/b] carrying a quiet, elusive mystery. He appears to watch every resident and every landscape of Pelican Town with thoughtful eyes, digesting the mundane details of life into narratives known only to himself.
His presence will bring a distinct new hue to the tranquil valley. A story of quest, remembrance, and inner peace is ready for you to discover.
This mod adds a fully custom NPC to Stardew Valley, complete with unique portraits, dialogue, schedules, and heart events. Dive into the life of this enigmatic traveler and uncover the secrets he carries.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Make sure you have the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b] installed. (Download from [url=https://smapi.io/]smapi.io[/url])[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and install the following required mods:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Content Patcher[/b] (Nexus ID: 1915) – [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915[/url] [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Portraiture[/b] (Nexus ID: 999) – [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999[/url] [/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download this mod and unzip the downloaded [/color]

[code].zip[/code][color=#D4D4D8] file.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Move the extracted mod folder (the one containing [/color]

[code]manifest.json[/code][color=#D4D4D8]) into your [/color]

[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8] folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI. The mod will be automatically loaded.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8](Optional) If you have other mods that affect NPCs, check for compatibility notes below.[/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]New NPC[/b]: "HaoChiYu" – a fully fleshed-out character with a rich personality and an independent backstory.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Custom Portraits & Sprites[/b]: Unique visual designs that match the game's original art style.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Original Dialogue[/b]: Over 100 lines of context‑sensitive dialogue that vary by season, weather, and heart level.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Daily Schedule[/b]: A realistic routine that takes him around Pelican Town, the beach, and the forest.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Gift Preferences[/b]: He has his own liked, disliked, and neutral items – discover them through trial and error![/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Roommate Option[/b]: Once you reach 10 hearts, you can invite him to become your roommate, and he will move into your farmhouse.[/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]SMAPI[/b] (version 3.18.0 or later) – the essential mod loader for Stardew Valley. Download from [url=https://smapi.io/]smapi.io[/url].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Content Patcher[/b] (version 1.30.0 or later) – required to load custom assets such as portraits, dialogue, and schedules.
Nexus ID: 1915 – [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915[/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Portraiture[/b] (version 1.0.0 or later) – required to enable dynamic portrait display and smooth integration with the game's portrait system.
Nexus ID: 999 – [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999[/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Game version[/b]: Stardew Valley 1.6 or later (compatible with the latest update).[/color][/*]
[/list]
